snippet.title: TIPADUMA — Full Story Run: Zombies, Ghosts and the Hag with an Axe | Free Browser Horror FPS
snippet.description:
A full run of the story mode "The Spellbook" in TIPADUMA, a free retro horror shooter that runs right in your browser. Cross the foggy garden, break into the haunted mansion, banish the ghosts and take the spellbook from the hag in the attic. At the end: the weapons in action, from a chainsaw to a rocket launcher.

Play free, no download: https://tipaduma.wogulgames.com
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wogulgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@wogulgames
